rules.rationale: Halogens add polarizable, poorly hydrated surface with positive Hansch pi; halogen_high is a sharp 98-candidate regime.
Aromatic carbon presents apolar pi surface that favors octanol transfer and dominates high-logP chemical space.
Many heteroatoms mean hydrogen-bond acceptors and possible ionization, raising aqueous affinity and depressing measured logD.
Polar surface without halogen compensation is the most hydrophilic regime; the two polarity terms reinforce rather than cancel.

skills.hypothesis: Direct partition mechanisms dominate: halogen and aromatic apolar surface raise lipophilicity while heteroatom polarity lowers it. Fails if measured logD is governed by ionizable groups or normalization compresses halogen effects.

rules.rationale: Rings were the largest transfer-weighted source role; fused carbocycles add rigid apolar surface favoring octanol partitioning.
Many branches imply rotatable polar arms that hydrate freely; this downweights the source rotatable-bond role as a lipophilicity driver.
Bulk raises logD only when polarity is scarce; heteroatom-poor large skeletons are the classical high-lipophilicity regime.
Source short SMILES were most soluble; small solutes expose little apolar surface, so analogue logD is expected low.

skills.hypothesis: Size and ring roles transfer from esol only as weak, polarity-gated priors, and the rotatable-bond relation is reversed to negative. Fails if pool variance is driven by halogen substructure rather than bulk, or if length bins are too skewed to discriminate.

normalized.lesson: Direct partition mechanism keeps beating transferred esol size/ring priors, though the margin narrowed at generation 1 (89.20 vs 88.85 AUC) and the transfer skill matched or exceeded it on two seeds. Source confidences of 0.16-0.41 on 512 observations of a different endpoint warrant damping, not inversion of the whole relation.
normalized.revision_summary: Repaired the schema violation by writing every conditions object as a direct catalog-field-to-value map instead of a nested pair list, using only exact public values. Kept the winning halogen/aromatic versus heteroatom-polarity skill with its four grounded rules and raised confidence slightly, since it again led on mean AUC and mean final best across the eight generation-1 seeds. The competing skill now drops the crowded long-SMILES main effect, retains the ring and short-length transfer roles with reduced weights, and carries the counter-hypothesis as an explicit negative rotatable/branch term that reverses the uncertain source rotatable_bond_bin relation; it keeps the heteroatom-poor large-skeleton interaction as the one mechanistically additive two-condition rule. Deployment stays with the direct-mechanism skill: its sparse halogen and heteroatom-polarity regimes are chemically interpretable and it showed smaller per-seed spread, while esol transfer remains a weak prior only.
